_comment: Calibration mixture for REAP on DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Weights are relative and
normalized, and are interpreted as a share of the sample count (so with
packing, roughly a share of tokens too). The mixture decides which experts
survive: an expert that never sees tokens it specializes in scores zero and
Same source list and weights as calib/mix.json so the two models' saliency
runs stay comparable. The small Chinese share is kept for the same reason as
there: DeepSeek is a Chinese-origin model, and experts handling shared
reasoning and grammar may have been co-trained on Chinese, so removing it
entirely risks pruning those along with the genuinely Chinese-specific ones.
On GLM-5.2 a zero-Chinese variant was tried and changed the retained sets
almost not at all (Jaccard 0.946), so this is a cheap safety margin rather
Tokenization differs from GLM-5.2 (vocab 129,280, different tokenizer), so
this mix must be built against the DeepSeek checkpoint directory:
_chat_template_note: DeepSeek-V4 ships no HF chat_template. Prompts are built by
automatically; chat_template_kwargs below are that function's arguments.
thinking_mode 'chat' emits '<|Assistant|></think>' -- the thinking block is
closed immediately and the model answers directly. None of the sources below
contain reasoning traces, so calibrating in 'thinking' mode would prompt for
a response shape the data does not have. If you intend to serve with
thinking enabled and want calibration to match, set thinking_mode to
'thinking' here and add sources that actually contain reasoning traces.
